capabilities: Apply and remove text colors using a custom syntax that integrates with Obsidian Markdown
Bundle color and formatting presets into themes selectable in settings
Override the active theme per note via a frontmatter property
Apply colors through a context menu, interactive delimiter, command, or coloring menu
extras: README lists known issues with reading mode (unopened =~ closing delimiter) and a planned-features roadmap including coloring by keyword.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to color individual text sections, and raw HTML coloring is not exposed in the editing view.
summary: Custom-syntax text colorer that applies, changes, and removes colored text spans through editor menus, commands, and keyboard shortcuts.
